first_output.what: Semiconductor stocks fell sharply as new chip export rules widened restrictions on AI and memory chip sales to certain markets. The regulatory tightening threatens revenue for companies heavily exposed to international semiconductor demand.
Eli Lilly surged after its obesity trial exceeded expectations, reinforcing the commercial potential of its weight-loss drug franchise in a rapidly growing market.
